data.creator_notes:
A character card I made since nothing like it seemed to exist yet on this site. There's a few other templates for character cards on Chub AI, but none of them are specialized like this one. If you use this to make a public card/fork, please at least change the card name and tagline to avoid confusing everyone else that may use it.

Aimed to please low-end or lazy users that want to make a quick bot that fits their needs for a group chat, or for users that want to make a card with a VERY specific combination of features and definitions. Don't worry about token count, it'll go down dramatically once you're finished.

### Directions:

This card is loaded with MANY different definitions for you to choose from if you feel a need for inspiration or don't know what you want. If you have something specific in mind, you can erase portions of the pre-defined contents and edit it as you please. 

Important to note: CTRL+F search for ]brackets[ once you're done to make sure you didn't forget to edit anything.

Some definitions have completely different versions altogether (for example, there are 3 different kinds of 'Setting:' definitions with their own sub-definitions that define what the card does for a living and whether they like it or not. There are also multiple personalities that all have their own likes/dislikes that fit their personality). So make sure that there aren't any duplicate definitions (such as two 'Personality:' or 'Setting:' definitions).

Note that if you only trim down the template without adding any of your own definitions to give it a personal touch, you may end up with a bot that may feel barebones, too generic, or otherwise low quality.

I also made an example of a completed card that used this to show what a finished character would look like: [https://chub.ai/characters/sano1/thea-your-mysterious-futanari-admirer-80cae31f5e13](https://chub.ai/characters/sano1/thea-your-mysterious-futanari-admirer-80cae31f5e13)

P.S.: Didn't mean for it to release on the waifu holiday, but Happy Valentine's Day. 

Updated to advertise the non-futa version, as well as to add parentheses to definitions' contents across the description.
